facts.text: By Miller's own clock the beacon has only been on for hours.
Tidally locked, shallow ocean, periodic giant waves.
The flight recorder shows Miller died on landing.
The ground near the lander holds nothing but water and wreckage.
Cooper is back aboard the Ranger, in orbit above Miller.

decisions.note: Wave warning at T = 60 000 000 s; the wave arrives at the deadline (hazard.wave). Staying longer recovers the recorder and costs an hour of Cooper's time for the flooded engines; Doyle dies when the wave arrives, not at the choice (GDD §5, placeholder numbers).
decisions.title: The wave is coming
decisions.prompt: A wall of water is crossing the plain and will reach you at the deadline. Run for the Ranger now, or spend an hour on Miller, about seven years for Romilly, to pull the recorder from the wreck while the wave closes in.

decisions.title: The supplies are running low
decisions.prompt: Hibernating stops his ageing and nearly all use of supplies, but he cannot act again until someone docks. Staying awake keeps him able to act while the stores run down.

decisions.note: Wake fallback for a hibernating Romilly: Cooper's docking wakes him. The slice ends when Cooper lifts off, before this triggers.
decisions.title: Bring the Ranger home
decisions.prompt: Dock with Endurance and wake Romilly.

lines.speaker: card
lines.text: Miller's planet

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The planet circles Gargantua, a spinning black hole. Down here an hour passes for every seven years aboard Endurance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Romilly waits in orbit. Every minute you spend on this surface is weeks of his life.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Knee-deep water, and a sky that is mostly one enormous black hole. Fine. We keep this short.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: The beacon is a short walk ahead. If it is still transmitting, this world may be habitable.

lines.speaker: char.doyle
lines.text: The gravity is heavy. The suit fights every step, so walk, don't run.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or the touch pad. Press E or the Act button when something can be done.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: It is live. And by this planet's own clock, it has only been on for a few hours.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: Hours here, years up there. A signal this young tells us the planet looked good a moment ago, not that it still does.

lines.speaker: char.doyle
lines.text: So the beacon proves very little. We should look around before we believe it.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Agreed. Search the surface.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: Debris in every direction, and the wreck of the first lander is out there, half under the water.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Nothing living. Nothing standing.

lines.speaker: char.doyle
lines.text: Cooper, that ridge on the horizon is moving.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: It is not a ridge. It is water, and it is coming this way.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: How long do we have?

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: Minutes. We can run for the Ranger now, or use the time to pull the recorder from that wreck. The engines will be wet if we wait.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Time is held until you choose.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Back to the Ranger, both of you. Now.

lines.speaker: char.doyle
lines.text: Strapped in. Go, go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When you are ready, lift off.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Brand, the recorder. Doyle, get the Ranger ready.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: I have it. Move, move.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When you are ready, lift off.

lines.speaker: char.brand
lines.text: Doyle? Doyle, answer me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wave took Doyle in the dark. It did not slow.

lines.speaker: char.cooper
lines.text: Lift off. Everyone who can still go.

lines.speaker: card
lines.text: Romilly. {tau:char.romilly} since Cooper left.

lines.speaker: char.romilly
lines.text: Another entry in the log, another line on the wall. Nobody has called.

lines.speaker: char.romilly
lines.text: I will keep the lights on and keep counting.

lines.speaker: char.romilly
lines.text: Supplies are down to a third. At this rate I will not see the end of the wait awake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hibernating stops his ageing and almost all use of supplies. Only a docking can wake him.

lines.speaker: char.romilly
lines.text: Timer set. Wake me when someone knocks.

lines.speaker: char.romilly
lines.text: Awake, then. Every day I stay up is a day of rations, and I know it.

outcomeNotes.text: You ran from the wave. Doyle lived, the engines stayed dry, and the flight recorder stayed on Miller.
You stayed for the recorder. Doyle died in the wave and the flooded engines cost an hour on Miller, which Romilly paid in years.
Romilly hibernated to make his supplies last.
Romilly stayed awake while his supplies ran down.
